blocks.orig: The Manor At Ngorongoro, lying between huge coffee plantations, offers a perfect combination of adventure and luxury. It has beautiful rooms with big bathrooms and the most comfortable beds. The staff are lovely and the food is of a very high quality. In short, the Manor completely lives up to any expectation you might have of a luxury hotel. And that shows in their customer reviews.
blocks.html: The Manor At Ngorongoro, surrounded by vast coffee plantations, brings adventure and luxury together beautifully. The rooms are lovely, with large bathrooms and very comfortable beds. The staff are wonderful and the food is of excellent quality. Put simply, the Manor meets every expectation you could have of a luxury hotel. Their guest reviews reflect that too.
